actions.name: list_available_rest_apis
actions.description: List available REST APIs. To retrieve the list of available REST API endpoints in your Zoho CRM organization for a specific API version. You can filter the results by module, OAuth scope, or request method using the filters parameter.

filters.description: This parameter allows you to filter the supported APIs for the version specified in the URL. You can filter based on three criteria: module, request method, and OAuth scope. The filter syntax is a JSON object with three fields: **field**, **comparator**, and **value**. The **field** can be one of the following: `module`, `operation_types.method`, or `operation_types.oauth_scope`. The **comparator** can be either `equals` or `contains`. The **value** is the value to filter by. Encode the filter while using it in any API platform.

actions.name: get_appointment_preferences
actions.description: Get Appointment Preferences. Fetches the existing configuration for appointment preferences, including rules for deal creation, job sheet visibility, and mark as complete configurations.

include.description:
Specify this key to fetch deal record configuration when **when_appointment_completed:create_deal**.
Possible values: **deal_record_configuration**.

actions.name: update_appointment_preferences
actions.description: Update Appointment Preferences. To update the appointment preference settings in your Zoho CRM organization, including booking constraints, job sheet requirements, deal creation configuration, and record-sharing settings.

appointment_preferences.description: Specify the appointment preferences to configure for the Zoho CRM organization.

show_job_sheet.description:
Represents whether filling out the job sheet is mandatory for marking an appointment as 'completed'. You can mandate job sheets only when **when_duration_exceeds: ask_appointment_provider_to_complete**.
Possible values:
**true** - Job sheet is mandatory for appointment completion.
**false** - Job sheet is not mandatory for appointment completion.

when_duration_exceeds.description:
Represents who has to mark the appointment as 'Completed' when the service duration gets over.
Possible values:
**mark_as_complete** - The appointment is automatically marked as 'completed'.
**ask_appointment_provider_to_complete** - User have to manually mark the appointment as 'completed'.

when_appointment_completed.description:
Represents whether a deal has to be created, when an appointment is completed.
Possible values:
**create_deal** - Deal is created when any appointment is marked 'Completed'.
**do_not_create_deal** - Deal is not created when any appointment is marked 'Completed'.

allow_booking_outside_service_availabili.description:
Denotes if you can create appointments outside service availability.
Possible values:
**true** - You can create appointments outside service availability.
**false** - You cannot create appointments outside service availability.

allow_booking_outside_businesshours.description:
Denotes if you can create appointments outside business hours. You can configure this preference only when **allow_booking_outside_service_availability:true**.
Possible values:
**true** - You can create appointments outside business hours.
**false** - You cannot create appointments outside business hours.

sharing_enabled.description: Set to true to enable sharing of the associated record in appointments with the appointment owner. When set to true, sharing_details must also be provided.

sharing_details.description: Sharing configuration for appointment-associated records. Defines the permission level granted to the appointment owner for the associated record. Required when sharing_enabled is set to true.

permission.description: The permission level granted to the appointment owner for the associated record.

deal_record_configuration.description: Specify the configuration for creating Deal records when an appointment is completed, including the layout and field mappings.

layout.description: Specify the Deals module layout to use when creating deal records from completed appointments.

id.description: Specify the unique identifier of the Deals module layout. You can get the ID using the [Get Layouts API](layouts.yaml#$.paths./settings/layouts.get).

name.description: Specify the name of the Deals module layout.

field_mappings.description: Specify the field mappings that define how appointment and service data populates the Deals module fields when a deal is created.

items.description: Each object specifies the details for each field mapping, including the target Deals module field, the mapping type, and the corresponding value.

type.description:
Specify the type of field mapping to use.
Possible values:
**static** - Set a fixed value for the deal field regardless of appointment data.
**merge_field** - Map the deal field value from appointment or service module data.

value.description:
Denotes the value of the Deals fields. The format of this key's value depends on the mapping **type**.

**Value for merge_field**: The datatype of this value is a string. To merge any field from a module, it should be specified like this **${module_api_name.field_api_name}**.
Example: ${Appointments__s.Appointment_Name}

**Value for static**: The datatype of this value is a JSON object. It contains the name and ID of the entity.

When you want to give static values that look up to a different module, make a GET API call of the specific module and provide the relevant ID and name of the record. You can also give standard text values enclosed in a string.

anyOf.description: Specify a merge-field expression that references appointment or service module data using the format **${!module_api_name.field_api_name}**.
Specify a structured static value for lookup and complex deal fields, provided as an object with a **name** and an **ID**.

field.description: Specify the Deals module field to which the appointment data is mapped. Use the [Get Fields API](fields.yaml#$.paths./settings/fields.get) call to fetch the API name and ID of the field.

api_name.description: Provide the API name of the Deals module field.

id.description: Provide the Unique ID of the Deals module field. Use the [Get Fields API](fields.yaml$#.paths./settings/fields.get) to get the valid API name and ID of the field.

actions.name: get_appointment_records
actions.description:
Get Appointment Records. To retrieve appointment records from your Zoho CRM organization. 

Use the `page` and `per_page` parameters to paginate up to 2,000 records, or use the `page_token` received in a prior response to paginate beyond 2,000 records up to a maximum of 100,000. Each request returns a maximum of 200 records. 

Subform data is not included when retrieving multiple appointments. The API returns field values containing sensitive health data only when the Restrict Data access through API option is disabled in compliance settings.

fields.description: Specify a comma-separated list of field API names to include in the response. Use the [Get Fields Metadata API](fields.yaml#$.paths./settings/fields.get) to retrieve the field IDs and API names.

cvid.description: Specify the unique ID of the Custom View. Use the [Get Custom Views Metadata API](custom_views.yaml#$.paths./settings/custom_views.get) to retrieve the Custom View IDs.

page_token.description: Specify the page token to retrieve records beyond the first 2,000 results. Use the **next_page_token** value from a previous response to access the next page of results.

page.description: Specify the page number to retrieve. Starts at 1.

per_page.description: Specify the number of records to return per page. Maximum is 200.

sort_order.description:
Specify the sort order for the records.
Possible values:
desc - Returns records in descending order.
asc - Returns records in ascending order.

sort_by.description: Specify the field to sort records by.  Possible values:**id** - Sorts by record ID.  **Created_Time** - Sorts by creation timestamp.  **Modified_Time** - Sorts by last modification timestamp.

actions.name: create_bulk_write_job
actions.description: Create a bulk write job. To create a bulk write job in your Zoho CRM organization that creates, updates, or upserts records in a target module from a previously uploaded file. The job is processed asynchronously; the response returns the job identifier that the get job details operation uses to poll job status, and an optional callback URL is notified on completion or failure.

insert - Creates the records from the file as new records in the target module.
update - Updates existing records in the target module without creating new ones.
upsert - Updates existing records and creates new records that do not exist already.

callback.description: Specify the callback configuration that Zoho CRM uses to notify your endpoint when the bulk write job completes or fails.

url.description: Specify the URL that receives the job completion notification. The URL must accept the HTTP POST method and be reachable from Zoho CRM servers.

method.description:

post - Sends the job completion notification as an HTTP POST request.

type.description:

actions.name: process_multiple_api_requests_in_single_call
actions.description: Process multiple API requests in a single call. To bundle multiple Zoho CRM API requests into a single HTTP call, reducing network round-trips and enabling request chaining. You can reference the output of one sub-request in another using the format **@{sub_request_id:JSONPath}** to build dependent workflows. When **rollback_on_fail** is enabled, all successful sub-requests are rolled back if any subsequent sub-request fails.

rollback_on_fail.description:
Specify whether to rollback the composite API request if any of the sub-requests fail. The default value is false.
Possible values:
**true** - Rollback all operations if any sub-request fails. Workflow automation actions execute only after all sub-requests succeed.
**false** - Process each sub-request independently without rollback.
This key cannot be **true** when **parallel_execution** is **true**.

parallel_execution.description:
Specify whether  to process all independent sub-requests (sub-requests with no dependencies/references) in parallel. The default value is true. If "rollback_on_fail" is true, then the default value of this key is false.
Possible values:
**true** - Execute independent sub-requests in parallel.
**false** - Execute sub-requests sequentially.
This key cannot be **true** when **rollback_on_fail** is **true**.

__composite_requests.description: Specify the API requests to execute as sub-requests within the composite call.

items.description: Each object represents an individual API sub-request, including the HTTP method, URI, and optional headers, parameters, and body.

method.description:
Specify the HTTP method for the corresponding sub-request.
Possible values:
**GET** - Retrieve data from the API.
**POST** - Create a new resource.
**PUT** - Update an existing resource.
**DELETE** - Remove a resource.
**PATCH** - Partially update a resource.

uri.description: Specify the URI path of the corresponding sub-request. The URI must follow the pattern **/crm/{version}/{endpoint}** with the regex `/crm(/.*)?/v[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?/.*`.

sub_request_id.description: Specify a unique identifier for the sub-request. Use this ID to reference the output of this sub-request. The accepted regex is `[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9_]*`.

headers.description: Specify the HTTP headers for the sub-request. The **authorization** and **x-crm-org** headers are restricted and cannot be used.

params.description: Specify the parameters for the sub-request.

body.description:
Specify the request body for the sub-request.

> **Note**
> - **Using References in Composite API Requests**: You can reference the output of one sub-request in another within the same API call.
> - **Reference Structure**: `@{sub_request_id:JSONPath}`
>   Where,
>   - `sub_request_id` is the ID of the sub-request whose response you want to reference.
>   - `JSONPath` is the path to the specific field in that response.
>   For example, if you create a Lead in one sub-request (sub_request_id : 1) and need to update it in another, you can use `@{1:$.data[0].details.id}` to dynamically fetch the Lead ID from sub-request 1 and use it in sub-request 2 to modify the same record. 
> - The `rollback_on_fail` and `parallel_execution` keys cannot both be set to `true`. If both are enabled, the API returns the `AMBIGUITY_DURING_PROCESSING` error.
> - All Delete APIs (except Notification APIs) support only record IDs in the URL. Bulk delete operations are not supported.
> - When `rollback_on_fail` is `false`:
>   - Workflows, approvals, and other automation actions are triggered as intended.
>   - The Composite API consumes one API credit.
> - When `rollback_on_fail` is `true`:
>    - **Workflows**
>      - Automation actions execute only after all sub-requests complete successfully and no rollback occurs. If one or more sub-requests fail and a rollback happens, the automation actions are not triggered.
>      - For example, consider the case where a workflow is triggered every time a lead is created with the company name starting with 'S'. In sub-request 1, a lead is created, whose Company name starts with 'S', and sub-request 2 edits the newly created record's company name so that it does not start with 'S'. Only after executing both the sub-requests the workflow will be executed. But in this case, the workflow will not be triggered because the newly created Lead's company name is already updated in sub-request 2, and the criterion for the workflow is not met. Consider another case, where in sub-request 1, a lead is created, whose Company name is 'Silicon Solutions', and sub-request 2 edits this newly created record's website. If none of the other sub-requests change the company name of this newly created record, after executing all the sub-requests successfully, the workflow will be triggered.
>    - When a rollback occurs, the Composite API consumes one API credit.
>    - When all sub-requests succeed, the Composite API consumes two API credits.
> - Each Composite API request consumes **five concurrency credits**, regardless of the number of sub-requests.
> - Each composite API reduces the sub-concurrency by one, while the sub-requests consume their respective sub-concurrencies.

### Allowed APIs
The following table gives the list of APIs allowed in a composite request. For these APIs, there are restrictions on the number of records that you can create, update, or delete in a composite request.

|  API | No. of records allowed |
| --- | --- |
| Get Org, Get Metadata, Convert a Lead, Get Layout Rules, Get Validation Rules, Get Custom Links, Get/Add/Update Roles, Get Profiles, Get Records' Count, Get/Update Blueprint, Get Variables/Variable Groups, Get Tags, Add/Remove Tags for a record, Get List of Attachments, Delete Photo, Get Currencies, Get Shared Record Details, Get Assignment Rules, Get/Add/Update Pipeline, Get Wizards, Get List of From Addresses, Delete Notifications | No Restriction | 
| Add/Update/Delete Users, Update/Delink Related Records, Add/Delete Variables, Create/Update/Delete Notes, Create/Update/Merge Tags, Add/Update Currency, Add/Update/PATCH Notifications, Create/Update/Upsert/Delete Records | 1 |
| Get Territories, Get Notes, Get Email/Inventory Templates, Get Notifications, Get/Search Records, Get Related Records, Get records through a COQL query, Get Deleted Records, Get Users | 25 |

actions.name: create_email_notifications
actions.description: Create Email Notifications. Creates an email notification action in your Zoho CRM organization by defining its name, associated module, email template, sender details, and recipients. The email notification can be linked to automation rules so that emails are automatically triggered when the specified conditions are met. A pre-existing Email Template is required before creating an email notification; the template ID must be referenced in the request payload.

email_notifications.description: Specify the email notification objects to create. The array must contain exactly one object.

items.description: Represents the writable fields for creating an email notification action in Zoho CRM. The module, name, recipients (with at least one entry in the to array), and template fields are required. Optionally configure from_address, reply_to_address, related_module, bulk_email, and feature_type.

name.description: Specify the display name of the email notification action. The following special characters are not allowed: ~`#%^&*()+={}[]|;"<>\.

module.description: Represents the CRM module associated with an email notification definition. Both api_name and id are required and must refer to the same module. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the CRM module whose records trigger the email notification. For example, Leads, Contacts, or Deals. Both api_name and id must refer to the same module.

id.description: Represents the unique numeric identifier of the CRM module. Both id and api_name must refer to the same module.

related_module.description: Represents the related module metadata for automation contexts that operate on related records. Null when no related module context applies.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the related CRM module used in the automation configuration, for example, Notes.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the related CRM module that corresponds to the api_name value.

template.description: Represents an email template reference used in an email notification definition. The template must belong to the same module as the notification, and both the id and name fields are required.

name.description: Represents the name of the email template associated with the email notification.

id.description: Represents the unique identifier of the email template.

recipients.description: Represents the recipient configuration for an email notification action, including primary, CC, and BCC recipient lists. The to field is mandatory and requires at least one entry. The cc and bcc fields are optional and are supported only when bulk_email is set to true. The to array can contain a maximum of 100 recipients, while the cc and bcc arrays can contain a maximum of 50 recipients each. A module can have one Multi-Select User Lookup field with up to 10 users; users selected through this lookup count toward the applicable recipient limit. For example, if 10 users are selected through the lookup, up to 90 additional recipients can be specified in the to array.

to.description: Represents the primary recipients of the email notification. At least one recipient entry is required.

items.description: Represents a recipient object used in the to, cc, and bcc arrays of an email notification's recipients configuration. Choose the variant based on the intended recipient type: merge_field resolves dynamically from the record (owner, created_by, or lookup email); emails specifies explicit email addresses; user targets a specific CRM user by ID; profile targets all users assigned to a profile; group targets all users in a group; role targets all users with a role; role_and_subordinate targets a role and its reporting hierarchy; territory targets a sales territory; territory_and_subterritory targets a territory and its sub-territory hierarchy. When bulk_email is true, only merge_field, emails, and user types are permitted in the to array — role, group, territory, role_and_subordinate, and territory_and_subterritory types are not allowed.

anyOf.description: Represents a recipient resolved dynamically from a merge field, where the recipient address depends on the triggering record and is resolved at runtime. Merge field recipients fall into two categories: INTERNAL — fields resolving to CRM users, such as ${!Module.Owner} or ${!Module.Created_By}, for which from_address must not be provided and defaults to the first registered email address; and EXTERNAL — fields resolving to email-type fields (ui_type=25), such as ${!Module.Email} or ${!Module.Lookup.Email}, for which from_address is required. Use module and field metadata APIs to retrieve valid field API names.

Represents the recipient type for this entry.
Possible values:
merge_field - Indicates that the recipient address is resolved dynamically from a record field at runtime.

details.description: Represents the merge-field details used to resolve the recipient address at runtime, including the field API name and an optional identifier.

resource.description: Represents the resource associated with the recipient. Not applicable for merge_field recipients; this field is always null.

associated_to.description: Represents the associated entity for the recipient. Not applicable for merge_field recipients; this field is always null.

anyOf.description: Represents a recipient configuration that uses explicit email addresses to specify notification targets. Provide one or more addresses in the details.emails array.

Represents the recipient type for this configuration.
Possible values:
emails - Indicates that recipients are specified using explicit email addresses.

associated_to.description: Represents the associated resource for this recipient type. Not applicable for direct email address recipients.

Represents the recipient type for the notification target. For direct user recipients, this value is always `user`.
Possible values:

team_module - The notification module is a private (team) module; only team-scoped users and profiles are included as recipients.
null - The notification module is a standard module; all applicable users and profiles are included.

Choose the variant based on the intended recipient type: merge_field resolves dynamically from the record (owner, created_by, or lookup email); emails specifies explicit email addresses; user targets a specific CRM user by ID; profile targets all users assigned to a profile; group targets all users in a group; role targets all users with a role; role_and_subordinate targets a role and its reporting hierarchy; territory targets a sales territory; territory_and_subterritory targets a territory and its sub-territory hierarchy. anyOf.description: Represents a recipient resolved dynamically from a merge field, where the recipient address depends on the triggering record and is resolved at runtime. resource.description: Represents the resource associated with the recipient. Not applicable for merge_field recipients; this field is always null.

from_address.description: Represents the sender (From) address configuration for an email notification. Supports three types: merge_field, user, and organization_email. from_address is auto-assigned by the API (defaults to notifications@zohocrm.com) when all recipients are internal (resolve to CRM users). Providing from_address when all recipients are internal returns DEPENDENT_MISMATCH error. When bulk_email is true, the configured From address is used instead of notifications@zohocrm.com, and the From address is required for mass emails. from_address is also required when any recipient resolves to an external email address, such as a merge field that resolves to an email-type field (for example, ${!Module.Email} where ui_type=25).

anyOf.description: Represents the address configuration for a merge_field type from or reply-to address in an email notification. Two hardcoded values are always available: ${!Current.User.Email} (the logged-in user's email) and ${!Record.Owner.Email} (the record owner's email). Any user lookup field available in the module can also be used as a from or reply-to address, for example, ${!Deals.Contact_Name.Email}. Use module and field metadata APIs to discover available user lookup fields.

type.description:
Represents the address type for this configuration.
Possible values:
merge_field - Indicates the address is resolved dynamically from a CRM module field or user lookup field.

details.description: Represents the merge field details used to resolve the sender or reply-to address. The api_name property is required for merge_field address types.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the merge field used to resolve the sender or reply-to address. Supported reference formats include ${!{module_API_name}.{field_API_name}} for direct fields and ${!{module_API_name}.{lookup_APIname}.{field_API_name}} for lookup fields.

id.description: Represents the optional identifier for the merge field.

resource.description: Represents the resource field, which is not applicable for merge_field address types and must be set to null.

type.description:
Represents the address type for the email notification recipient configuration.
Possible values:
user - Indicates that the recipient address is resolved from a Zoho CRM user.

resource.description: Represents a user identifier object used to resolve a CRM user by their numeric identifier. The name field is informational only and is not used to resolve the user record.

name.description: Represents the display name of the user. This value is informational only; the API uses the id field to resolve the user record.

id.description: Represents the unique numeric identifier of the user. Refer to the [Get users](users.yaml#$.paths./users.get) endpoint for details.

details.description: Represents additional address details. This field is not applicable when the type is set to `user` and should be omitted or set to null.

When any recipient resolves to an external email address — such as a merge field that resolves to an email-type field where ui_type is 25 — the reply_to_address is required.

actions.name: delete_email_notification_by_id
actions.description: Delete an Email Notification by ID. Deletes a single email notification configured in your Zoho CRM organization. Email notifications associated with an Approval Process, Workflow Rules, or Blueprint cannot be deleted until they are disassociated from the corresponding automation.

id.description: Specify the unique ID of the email notification to delete.  Notifications associated with active automation cannot be deleted  - returns NOT_ALLOWED

actions.name: get_email_notification_action_usage_reports
actions.description: Get Email Notification Action Usage Reports. Retrieves usage statistics for email notification actions executed in your Zoho CRM organization over a specified date range, grouped by date, resource, or type according to the group_by parameter.

group_by.description:
Specify the grouping criteria for usage report data. The value must include `date`. Two combinations are accepted:
`date` - Returns daily totals; the response omits the resource object, and the count represents the total number of alerts sent that day.
`date,resource` - Returns per-action rows with the resource identifier and name populated; type is an optional addition.

type.description:
Specify the automation feature type to filter usage data. When omitted, returns usage across all supported feature types.
Possible values:
workflow_rules - Filters usage data for Workflow Rules.
approval_process - Filters usage data for Approval Processes.
blueprint - Filters usage data for Blueprint Processes.
orchestrations - Filters usage data for Orchestrations.
wizards - Filters usage data for Wizards.
modules - Filters usage data for module-level limits.
email_notifications - Filters usage data for email notification actions.
email_templates - Filters usage data for Email Templates.
kiosks - Filters usage data for Kiosks.
cadences - Filters usage data for Cadences.
connected_workflows - Filters usage data for connected workflows.

from.description: Specify the start date (inclusive) for the date range filter, in YYYY-MM-DD format. The date is evaluated in the organization's time zone. When omitted, defaults to 30 days before the value set for the end date parameter. Future dates return an INVALID_DATA error.

to.description: Specify the end date (inclusive) for the query range in YYYY-MM-DD format. Evaluated in the organization's time zone. Defaults to the current date at 23:59:59 when omitted. Future dates return a 400 error with the code INVALID_DATA and the message 'provided_time_is_ahead'.

page.description: Specify the page number to retrieve results from. The first page is page one.

per_page.description: Specify the number of records to return per page. The maximum value is 200.

sort_order.description:
Specify the sort order for the results.
Possible values:
desc - Sorts the results in descending order.
asc - Sorts the results in ascending order.

include_inner_details.description: Specify the additional nested fields to include in usage report resource objects. Currently, only `resource.layout_id` is supported, which adds the layout ID inside the resource object when available, primarily for wizard usage rows. Other values are silently ignored.

actions.name: email_templates
actions.description: Email Templates. To retrieve a paginated list of email templates accessible to the authenticated user in your Zoho CRM organization. The list can be scoped to a specific CRM module using the module parameter, filtered by category (such as favorite, draft, or created_by_me), and refined using a structured filter expression. Results are sortable by last_usage_time, modified_time, or name, and paginated using the page and per_page parameters.

module.description: Provide the API name of the CRM module to filter Email Templates by. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for module API name.

per_page.description: Provide the maximum number of Email Template records to return per page. Default value is **200** and the maximum value is **200.**

page.description: Specify the page number to retrieve in a paginated response. The default value is 1.

actions.name: get_email_sharing_details_for_record
actions.description: Get email sharing details for a record. To retrieve the email sharing details for a specific record in your Zoho CRM organization, including the users whose email accounts are accessible and the available email filter options for the record's email view.

moduleApiName.description:
Specifies the **API name** of the module for which you want to retrieve the email sharing details. 
Possible values: **Leads**, **Contacts**, **Accounts**, **Deals**, **CustomModule1**. 
Refer to the [Retrieve CRM module metadata](modules.json#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values.

id.description: Specify the **ID** of the **record** for which you want to retrieve the email sharing details.

actions.name: features
actions.description: Features. To retrieve the list of all features available in your Zoho CRM organization for the current subscription edition, along with their usage limits and component details.

module.description: Specify the API name of the CRM module to filter features that are specific to that module. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.json#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values.

api_names.description: Specify the feature API names to filter the response. To retrieve details of more than one feature, provide the names in comma-separated format. Possible values: custom_field - Feature API name for the custom field feature. custom_field,encrypt_field,unique_field,private_fields,external_field,personal_health_fields - Feature API names for multiple features specified together. encrypt_field - Feature API name for the encrypt field feature. external_field - Feature API name for the external field feature. personal_health_fields - Feature API name for the personal health fields feature. private_fields - Feature API name for the private fields feature. unique_field - Feature API name for the unique field feature.

per_page.description: Specify the number of features to return per page. Possible values: 10 - Returns ten features per page.

page.description: Specify the page number to retrieve features from the corresponding results page. Possible values: 1 - Retrieves features from page one. 2 - Retrieves features from page two.

actions.name: specific_feature
actions.description: Specific Feature. To retrieve the detailed information for a specific feature in your Zoho CRM organization, including its usage limits, consumption details, and sub-feature components.

feature.description: Specify the API name of the feature for which you want to retrieve detailed information.

module.description: Specify the API name of the CRM module to filter features that are specific to that module. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.json#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values.

actions.name: user_licenses_feature
actions.description: User Licenses Feature. To get the user licenses feature details for the current edition

actions.name: rich_text_field_content_for_multiple_records
actions.description: Rich text field content for multiple records. Retrieves the full content of rich text multi-line fields for multiple records in a single request. Both the 'ids' and 'fields' query parameters are mandatory. You can specify up to 200 record IDs in the 'ids' parameter and up to 8 rich text field API names in the 'fields' parameter. This API exclusively fetches rich text fields - other field types are not supported. Only data from rich text multi-line fields can be retrieved; multi-line fields of other types (small, large) are not supported.

moduleApiName.description: The API name of the CRM module containing the record(s) whose rich text fields you want to retrieve (e.g., Leads, Contacts, Deals, Accounts). This is a mandatory path parameter.

fields.description: A comma-separated list of rich text field API names whose values you want to retrieve. Mandatory when retrieving rich text fields for multiple records (maximum 8 field API names). actions.name: upload_files_to_zfs
actions.description: Upload files to ZFS. To upload one or more files to the Zoho File System (ZFS) in your Zoho CRM account. The API returns an encrypted file ID for each uploaded file, which you can use to attach the file to a file upload field, image upload field, or record image field through the Create or Update Records API. The file is uploaded using multipart/form-data with a required 'file' field containing the binary data of the file to be uploaded. The response includes the file ID, name, status, and other details. Can upload 10 files in a single request by repeating the 'file' field. Maximum file size is 20 MB.

inline.description: Specify the upload type for inline images. Possible values: **inline** - Upload the file as an inline image for use in email templates or rich-text fields.

file.description: Upload one or more files using repeated **file** keys in the multipart form data. One or more files: [{"file": "/work/..."}]

actions.name: retrieve_file_from_zfs
actions.description: Retrieve a file from ZFS. To retrieve the binary content of a file stored in Zoho File System (ZFS) using its unique file ID. The file ID is provided as a required query parameter 'id'. If the file exists, the API returns the file's binary data along with appropriate headers indicating the MIME type and content disposition for download. If the file ID does not correspond to any file in ZFS, a 204 No Content response is returned. This endpoint is used to download files that have been previously uploaded to ZFS and associated with Zoho CRM records.

id.description: Specify the encrypted file ID received in the response when uploading files to the Zoho File System. Use the [ZFC API](files.yaml#$.paths./files.get) to retrieve the File IDs.

actions.name: list_functions
actions.description: Functions. To retrieve a paginated list of all [functions](https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/functions/overview/introduction.html) in your Zoho CRM account. The response contains metadata about each function, including its name, API name, runtime, category, state, arguments, tags, and timestamps. To get the implementation code of a function, you must use the [Download Function Code API](functions.yaml#$.paths./settings/functions/{fxIdentifier}/code.get).

page.description:
Specify the page number to retrieve records. The **page** parameter, together with the **per_page** parameter, supports retrieving the first 2,000 records. To retrieve records beyond the first 2,000, use the **page_token** parameter. 
Do not use this parameter with the page_token parameter.

**Possible Values:** Positive integers

**Default Value:** 1

per_page.description:
Specify the maximum number of functions to retrieve per page. This value also determines the number of functions returned when the corresponding **page_token** is used. You cannot use this parameter with the **page_token** parameter.

**Possible Values:** 1 to 200.

**Default Value:** 200.

page_token.description: The token to retrieve functions beyond the first 2000 records. Use the **next_page_token** or **previous_page_token** value from the previous response to retrieve the next or previous set of functions, respectively. The API returns the same number of functions as the **per_page** value used in the request that generated the token. If **page_token** is specified along with **page** or **per_page**, the **page_token** value takes precedence.

get_related_records_count.description: Represents the array of related list count request objects. Each object specifies a related list to query and optional filtering criteria to apply before counting.

items.description: Represents a single related list count specification, including the target related list and optional filtering criteria to apply before counting.

related_list.description: Represents a related list identified by its API name and unique ID. Used in both the request to specify the target related list and in the response to echo the queried related list.

actions.name: get_global_picklists
actions.description: Get All Global Picklists. Fetches the list of global picklists available in the organization along with their details. pick_list_values, used_in_modules, and associated_fields_count can be included in the response based on the "include" query parameter. The response can be filtered in three ways: use the "fields" query parameter to filter by key, so that only the requested keys along with "id" are returned; use the "filters" query parameter to filter the global picklists themselves by the value of a key; and use the "inner_details_filters" query parameter to filter the inner details of the global picklists. A 204 is returned when no global picklists exist.

items.description: Allowed values for including related resources in the response.

include.description: Comma-separated list of related resources to include. Allowed values: "used_in_modules", "pick_list_values", "associated_fields_count". Use CSV encoding (style=form, explode=false) for multiple values, e.g. include=used_in_modules,pick_list_values.

include_inner_details.description: Optional detailed expansion keys. Currently only allowed when `used_in_modules` is present in `include`. Allowed value: used_in_modules.plural_label.

items.description: The api_name of a global picklist key to be returned in the response.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of the api_names of the global picklist keys to be returned in the response, which lets you filter the response by key. Only the requested keys along with `id` are returned. Keys need not be unique — a key repeated in the list is processed once and the duplicates are ignored. Use CSV encoding (style=form, explode=false) for multiple values, e.g. fields=display_label,api_name,customizable.

inner_details_filters.description: JSON array used to filter the inner details returned for each global picklist in the list response. Each entry gives the inner resource in "api_name" and the criteria to apply in "filters", both of which are mandatory. Only "pick_list_values" is supported in "api_name", and within it only the "type" key can be filtered on, using the "equal" and "not_equal" comparators with the value "used" or "unused". "filters" takes either a single criteria using "field", "comparator" and "value", or a set of criteria in "group" combined using "group_operator", and a group may be nested inside another group. Use the "filters" query parameter instead to filter the global picklists themselves.

filters.description: JSON object used to filter the global picklists by the value of a key. Give either a single criteria using "field", "comparator" and "value", or a set of criteria in "group" combined using "group_operator". "group" and "group_operator" are mandatory to each other, and within a criteria "comparator" and "value" are dependent on "field". Only the "api_name", "source" and "customizable" keys can be filtered on; any other key returns a 400 with the code NOT_SUPPORTED. The string keys "api_name" and "source" support the "equal" and "not_equal" comparators with a string value, and the boolean key "customizable" supports only the "equal" comparator with a boolean value. Criteria cannot be nested inside another "group".

Clone a Kiosk. To clone an existing kiosk in Zoho CRM and create a new one from it. Cloning lets you reuse the full structure and configuration of a kiosk — including all its states, transitions, screens, actions, and decisions — without rebuilding it from scratch. criteria.description: Represents the top-level filter criterion for data selection, supporting both simple field-based filters and complex grouped filters with logical operators.

anyOf.description: Represents a simple field-based filter criterion that dispatches to the appropriate comparator-specific schema. The equal and not_equal comparators support scalar or array values; text comparators support scalar or array strings; ordering comparators require a scalar; between and not_between comparators require a two-element array; in and not_in comparators require an array of primitives; and include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators require an array of lookup objects and apply only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.
Represents an equality filter criterion that dispatches to either the EqualFilterCriterionRequest or NotEqualFilterCriterionRequest schema based on the comparator value.

Represents a filter criterion for the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders. Accepts scalar or array values. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

The equal and not_equal comparators support scalar or array values; text comparators support scalar or array strings; ordering comparators require a scalar; between and not_between comparators require a two-element array; in and not_in comparators require an array of primitives; and include_all, include_any, exclude_all, and exclude_any comparators require an array of lookup objects and apply only when the field's data_type is multiuserlookup or multiselectlookup.
Represents an equality filter criterion that dispatches to either the EqualFilterCriterionRequest or NotEqualFilterCriterionRequest schema based on the comparator value.

Represents a filter criterion for the equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders. Accepts scalar or array values. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the equal comparison operator applied to the criterion.
Possible values:
equal - Matches records where the field value equals the specified filter value.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:
Indicates the value resolution mode of the criterion, distinguishing whether the filter value is a literal value, a merge field reference, a predefined system variable, or another field reference.
Possible values:
value - The value is a direct literal.
merge_field - The value is a merge field reference.
pre_defined - The value is a predefined system variable placeholder.
field - The value references another field.

anyOf.description: Represents a filter criterion for the not_equal comparator. The value type is determined by the field's data_type: use SimpleFilterCriterionValueString for text, textarea, email, phone, website, autonumber, picklist, multiselectpicklist, date, or datetime fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueNumber for integer, currency, or double fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueBoolean for Boolean fields; SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectRequest for lookup, ownerlookup, or userlookup fields; and SimpleFilterCriterionValueObjectPredefined for predefined user or role object placeholders.

field.description: Represents the target field definition to which the not-equal filter criterion is applied, conforming to the base field structure.

comparator.description:
Represents the not-equal comparison operator applied to the criterion.

not_equal - Matches records where the field value does not equal the specified filter value.

value.description: Represents the filter value used in the not_equal comparator. Accepts a scalar or an array of values, depending on the field's data_type.

type.description:

anyOf.description: Represents a filter criterion for the like, not_like, starts_with, ends_with, contains, and not_contains comparators. Resolve the data_type from the field's FieldSchema.

api_name.description: Represents the API name of the field used for filter application. Supports relationship notation, for example, Deals__r.Stage.

like - Matches records where the field value contains the specified pattern.
not_like - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified pattern.
starts_with - Matches records where the field value begins with the specified string.
ends_with - Matches records where the field value ends with the specified string.
contains - Matches records where the field value contains the specified string.
not_contains - Matches records where the field value does not contain the specified string.

value.description: Represents the string filter value used in the text comparator. Accepts a scalar string or an array of string values.

actions.description:
Kiosk GetRecord. To delete a specific [GetRecords](https://help.zoho.com/portal/en/kb/crm/customize-crm-account/kiosk/articles/elements-of-a-kiosk#GetRecords) configuration associated with a Kiosk.
Use the [GetRecords Associations API](kiosks_get_records.yaml#$.paths./settings/kiosks/{kioskId}/get_records/{getRecordId}/associations.get) to identify all associations of the GetRecords configuration. Remove the associations from the respective Kiosk components, and then delete the GetRecords configuration.
Use the [Get All Kiosks API](kiosks.yaml#$.paths./settings/kiosks.get) to retrieve the Kiosk ID and use the [Kiosk GetRecords API](kiosks_get_records.yaml#$.paths./settings/kiosks/{kioskId...

actions.name: get_records_associations

GetRecords Associations. This API returns all the associations of a specific [GetRecords](https://help.zoho.com/portal/en/kb/crm/customize-crm-account/kiosk/articles/elements-of-a-kiosk#GetRecords) configuration. Associations represent where the configuration is being used, such as:
  - Kiosk states
  - Actions
  - Other dependent elements

This API helps you understand the dependencies of a GetRecords configuration before [modifying](kiosks_states.yaml#$.paths./settings/kiosks/{kioskId}/states/{stateId}.put)  or [deleting](kiosks_states.yaml#$.paths./settings/kiosks/{kioskId}/states/{stateId}.delete) it. 


**Note:** Predefined states, start state and end state, cannot be deleted.

actions.name: get_kiosk_states
actions.description:
Get all states of a kiosk. To retrieve all the states configured in a kiosk in your Zoho CRM organization, along with their transition details and basic metadata such as name, type, and associated fields. Each state represents a screen, action, decision, or GetRecords.

Available in: Standard, Professional, Enterprise, and Ultimate editions.

include.description:
Specify additional properties to be included in the response for each Kiosk state. By default, the response returns only the basic metadata of each state which includes each state's id, name, and associated_fields.

**Possible values:**

actions.name: create_kiosk_state
actions.description:
Create a kiosk state. Creates a state (screen, action, decision, or GetRecords) in a Kiosk identified by Kiosk ID. Only **one state** can be created per request.

The Kiosk must be in **draft** status; use the [Clone a Kiosk API](kiosks.yaml#$.paths./settings/kiosks/{kioskId}/actions/clone.post) if it is published or inactive. Call this API repeatedly to add more states, then [publish](kiosks.yaml#$.paths./settings/kiosks/{kioskId}/actions/activate.put) the Kiosk and [associate](kiosks_get_records.yaml#$.paths./settings/kiosks/{kioskId}/associations.put) it with the required CRM component. To modify an existing state, use the [Update Kiosk States API](kiosks_state.yaml#$.paths./settings/k...

kioskId.description: Specify the unique identifier of the Kiosk.

actions.description:
Get a specific kiosk state by ID. To retrieve the complete configuration of one specific state within a kiosk in Zoho CRM, including its transitions, associated fields, and configured properties. Use the include_inner_details query parameter to expand nested type information. The response structure varies based on the state type: screen, decision, action, or get_records.

To obtain the state ID required for this request, use the [Get Kiosk States API](kiosks_states.yaml#$.paths./settings/kiosks/{kioskId}/states.get)

To obtain the Kiosk ID required for this request, use the [Get Kiosks API](kiosks.yaml#$.paths./settings/kiosks.get)

actions.name: kiosk_state
actions.description:
Kiosk State. To update a particular state in a specific Kiosk in Zoho CRM using the Kiosk ID and state ID. Each state represents a screen, action, decision, or GetRecords.
A Kiosk must be in the draft status to update a state. This operation is not supported when the Kiosk is in the published or inactive status.
You can update only one state per request.
The state must already exist before it can be updated. To create a new state, use the [Create a Kiosk State API](kiosks_states.yaml#$.paths./settings/kiosks/{kioskId}/states.post). Once the Kiosk is fully configured, [publish](kiosks.yaml#$.paths./settings/kiosks/{kioskId}/actions/activate.put) it and [associate](kiosks_get_records.yaml#$...

actions.name: delete_kiosk_state
actions.description: Delete a kiosk state. To delete a specific state from a kiosk configuration in your Zoho CRM account. Removing a state eliminates all its associated configurations, transitions, and connected elements. Use the delete_dependent_states query parameter to control whether dependent states are also removed or left as disconnected components. The kiosk must be in draft status to perform this action. Predefined states (start state and end state) cannot be deleted. Available in Standard, Professional, Enterprise, and Ultimate editions.

delete_dependent_states.description:
When a state is deleted, all its associated configurations, transitions, and connected elements are removed. Use the delete_dependent_states query parameter to control whether dependent/child states should also be deleted or left as disconnected components. The default value is true.
Possible values:
true
false

actions.name: get_layouts
actions.description: Get layouts metadata. To retrieve the layout configurations for a specified module in your Zoho CRM organization.  **Note:** - The **profiles** array is **null** if the user does not have the Module Customization permission in their profile. - For the Deals module, when the pipeline feature is enabled, multiple layouts exist per pipeline, each with its own set of layouts. - Score and Visit Summary sections are system-generated and read-only. - The API returns all layouts for the module in a single response; pagination is not supported.

module.description: Specify the API name of the required module. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values.

mode.description: Specify the layout mode to filter the response. Available modes vary by module type. Possible values: `all` - Request all available layout modes. `business_card` - Business card layout view. `quick_create` - Quick create form layout.

include.description: Specify additional data to include in the response beyond the default layout structure. Possible values: `total_profiles` — include the total count of profiles associated with each layout. `portal_user_types` — include portal user type associations for each layout.

include_inner_details.description: Specify additional inner details to include in the response for each field. Possible values: `fields.allowed_permissions_to_update` - Include the set of permissions eligible for update per field. `fields.portal_user_types` - Include portal user type permission entries per field.

include_element_types.description: Specify the type of field component in the layout, distinguishing standard fields from mirror fields that derive their value from a lookup source. Possible values: `field` — a standard data field in the layout. `mirror_field` — a field that reflects a value from a related module lookup.

actions.name: get_layout_by_id
actions.description: Get layout by ID. To retrieve the details of a specific layout by its layout ID for a specified module in your Zoho CRM account.  **Important Notes:** - The `profiles` array is `null` when the user does not have "Module Customization" permission in their profile. - For Deals module: When the pipeline feature is enabled, multiple layouts exist per pipeline. Each pipeline can have its own set of layouts. - The `mode` parameter filters the layout by mode. Possible values: **all**, **business_card**, **quick_create**. - Score and Visit Summary sections are system-generated and read-only.  **Prerequisite:** The layout ID can be obtained from the Get All Layouts API.

id.description: Specify the unique identifier of the layout. Refer to the [Get Layouts](layouts.yaml#$.paths./settings/layouts.get) resource for valid values.

module.description: Specify the API name of the required module. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values.

mode.description: Specify the layout mode to filter the response. Available modes vary by module type. Possible values: `all` - Request all available layout modes. `business_card` - Business card layout view. `quick_create` - Quick create form layout.

include.description: Specify additional data to include in the response beyond the default layout structure. Possible values: `total_profiles` — include the total count of profiles associated with each layout. `portal_user_types` — include portal user type associations for each layout.

include_inner_details.description: Specify additional inner details to include in the response for each field. Possible values: `fields.allowed_permissions_to_update` - Include the set of permissions eligible for update per field. `fields.portal_user_types` - Include portal user type permission entries per field.

include_element_types.description: Specify the type of field component in the layout, distinguishing standard fields from mirror fields that derive their value from a lookup source. Possible values: `field` — a standard data field in the layout. `mirror_field` — a field that reflects a value from a related module lookup.

actions.name: update_layout
actions.description: Update a custom layout. To update a custom layout in your Zoho CRM organization, including renaming it, modifying profile permissions, enabling or disabling the business card display, and creating, updating, or deleting sections and fields within sections.

id.description: Specify the unique identifier of the layout. Refer to the [Get Layouts](layouts.yaml#$.paths./settings/layouts.get) resource for valid values.

module.description: Specify the API name of the required module. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values.

layouts.description: Contains exactly one layout object defining the update operations to be applied, including sections, profiles, and display settings.

items.description: Represents the layout configuration object supplied in an update request, containing at least one of the updatable attributes: name, sections, profiles, or business card display setting.

name.description: Represents the new display name for the layout. Must be unique within the module's layout configurations.

show_business_card.description: Specifies whether the business card view is enabled or disabled for this layout as part of the update.

profiles.description: Contains the array of profile objects to be added to or removed from the layout's profile associations in this update operation.

items.description: Represents a profile operation object used in layout update requests to add a profile to or remove a profile from the layout's permission associations.

id.description: Represents a unique numeric identifier for a CRM entity, expressed as a 64-bit integer serialized as a string to preserve precision in JSON.

_delete.description: Indicates whether this profile's association with the layout should be removed. Possible values: `true` — the profile is disassociated from the layout; `false` — the profile association is retained or added.

sections.description: Contains the array of section objects to be created, modified, or deleted as part of this layout update, defining the field and configuration changes within each section.

items.description: Represents a section operation object used in layout update requests to create, modify, or delete a section within the layout, including its label, field assignments, column count, and sequence.

id.description: Represents a unique numeric identifier for a CRM entity, expressed as a 64-bit integer serialized as a string to preserve precision in JSON.

name.description: Represents the internal API name of the section. Required when creating a new section through a layout update.

display_label.description: Represents the heading label of the section as displayed in the CRM interface. Required when creating a new section.

sequence_number.description: Indicates the one-based ordinal position of the section within the layout, controlling the order in which sections are rendered.

tab_traversal.description: Specifies the tab key navigation direction within the section. Defines how focus moves between fields when users press Tab. Possible values: `left_to_right` — focus moves horizontally across columns first. `top_to_bottom` — focus moves vertically down each column first.

column_count.description: Indicates the number of columns in which fields are arranged within this section when the layout is rendered on record forms.

fields.description: Contains the array of field operations to perform within this section, including adding, updating, creating, or removing field entries.

items.description: Represents a field operation object used in layout update requests to add, modify, create, or remove a field within a section.

id.description: Unique identifier of an existing field. Required when adding, updating position, or removing an existing field. Omit when creating a new custom field.

field_label.description: Represents the display label shown for the field in the CRM interface. Required when creating a new custom field through a layout update.

data_type.description: Represents the data type of the field. Required when adding a new custom field to the layout. Possible values: `text`, `textarea`, `email`, `phone`, `website`, `integer`, `bigint`, `currency`, `double`, `percent`, `date`, `datetime`, `boolean`, `picklist`, `multiselectpicklist`, `lookup`, `multiselectlookup`, `autonumber`, `fileupload`, `imageupload`, `formula`, `rollup_summary`, `consent_lookup`, `profileimage`, `richtextarea`, `userlookup`, `multiuserlookup`, `event_reminder`.

length.description: Represents the maximum number of characters permitted for this field's value. Applicable to text and textarea field types.

sequence_number.description: Represents the one-based ordinal position of the field within its containing section, controlling the rendering order of fields on record forms.

element_type.description: Represents the element type for special field components in the layout, distinguishing standard data fields from mirror fields. Possible values: `field` — a standard data field. `mirror_field` — a field that mirrors a value from a lookup source.

lookup_field.description: Represents the source lookup field from which a mirror field derives its value, establishing the cross-module field reference for mirror field creation.

_delete.description: Delete configuration for removing the field. Set permanent to false to move to unused section (can be re-added later), true to permanently delete the field and its data.

association_details.description: Association details for Field-Of-Lookup (FOL) mapping. Links this field to a related field in another module through a lookup field.

_delete.description: Represents the configuration object used to specify the deletion mode when removing a layout or resource, indicating whether the deletion is permanent or a soft delete to the recycle bin.

permanent.description: Indicates whether the resource is removed irrecoverably or placed in the recycle bin for potential recovery. Possible values: `true` — the resource is permanently destroyed and cannot be restored; `false` — the resource is moved to trash and may be recovered before final purge.

actions.name: delete_custom_layout
actions.description: Delete a custom layout. To delete a custom layout from a module in your Zoho CRM organization. When the layout being deleted has associated records, a target layout must be specified to receive the transferred records and profile associations. If the layout has an associated pipeline, the target pipeline and stage must also be provided. Specifying a transfer target is optional only when the layout is deactivated and has no associated records. Only one custom layout can be deleted per API call, and the standard layout cannot be deleted.

id.description: Specify the unique identifier of the layout. Refer to the [Get Layouts](layouts.yaml#$.paths./settings/layouts.get) resource for valid values.

module.description: Specify the API name of the required module. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values.

transfer_to.description: Specify the ID of the layout to which records associated with the current layout move upon layout deletion or deactivation. Refer to the [Get Layouts](layouts.yaml#$.paths./settings/layouts.get) resource for valid values.

pipeline.description: Specify the ID of the pipeline to transfer records to when deleting or deactivating a layout. Refer to the [Get Pipelines](pipeline.yaml#$.paths./settings/pipeline.get) resource for valid values.

stage.description: Specify the ID of the stage within the pipeline to assign transferred records when deleting or deactivating a layout. Refer to the [Get Pipelines](pipeline.yaml#$.paths./settings/pipeline.get) resource for valid values.

actions.name: activate_layout
actions.description: Activate Layout. Activates a single deactivated layout, making it available for use within the specified module. Optionally allows adding or removing profile associations during activation. Only one layout can be activated per request. This operation is idempotent - attempting to activate an already active layout returns an error (ALREADY_ACTIVATED).  The status key in the response from the [Get Layouts API](layouts.yaml#$.paths./settings/layouts.get) indicates whether the layout is active or inactive.

id.description: Specify the unique identifier of the layout to activate or deactivate. Refer to the [Get Layouts](layouts.yaml#$.paths./settings/layouts.get) resource for valid values.

module.description: Specify the API name of the module that contains the layout. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values.

layouts.description: Specify the array containing exactly one layout object to activate. The layout includes its unique identifier and optionally the profiles to associate or disassociate. Profile associations can be added (default) or removed (using _delete flag). The array must contain exactly one item.

items.description: Specify the layout configuration, including its unique identifier and the profile associations to add or remove during activation.

id.description: Specify the unique identifier of the deactivated layout to activate. Must reference an existing deactivated layout within the specified module. The ID is represented as a string containing a 64-bit integer value. Layout IDs are data center-specific. The status key in the response from the [Get Layouts Metadata API](layouts.yaml#$.paths./settings/layouts.get) indicates whether the layout is **active** or **inactive**.

profiles.description: Specify the profile associations to add to or remove from the layout during activation. Omitting this field or providing an empty array preserves existing profile associations. Refer to the [Get Profiles](profiles.yaml#$.paths./settings/profiles.get) resource for valid values. Use the _delete flag to remove existing associations. Empty array or omitting this field entirely preserves existing profile associations. At least one profile must remain associated with the layout after all operations are applied. While duplicate profile IDs are technically allowed, they cause unnecessary processing and should be avoided.

items.description: Specify a profile to associate with or disassociate from the layout.

id.description: Specify the unique identifier of the profile to associate with or disassociate from the layout. Must be a profile that exists in the CRM organization and is associated with the specified module. The ID is represented as a string containing a 64-bit integer value. Refer to the [Get Profiles](profiles.yaml#$.paths./settings/profiles.get) resource for valid values.

_delete.description: Specify whether to remove this profile's association from the layout. Possible values: **true** - Removes the profile association from the layout. **false** - Adds or retains the profile association on the layout.

actions.name: deactivate_layout
actions.description: Deactivate Layout. Deactivates an active layout and transfers its configuration (profile associations, permissions, field mappings) to another active layout within the same module. At least one active layout must remain in the module. This operation is idempotent - attempting to deactivate an already deactivated layout returns an error (ALREADY_DEACTIVATED).

id.description: Specify the unique identifier of the layout to activate or deactivate. Refer to the [Get Layouts](layouts.yaml#$.paths./settings/layouts.get) resource for valid values.

module.description: Specify the API name of the module that contains the layout. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values.

transfer_to.description: Specify the unique identifier of an active layout within the same module to which the deactivated layout's profile associations and configuration will be transferred. The target layout must be different from the layout being deactivated. Refer to the [Get Layouts](layouts.yaml#$.paths./settings/layouts.get) resource for valid values.

actions.name: send_mail_merge_email
actions.description: Send mail merge email. To send a personalized email to one or more recipients using a mail merge template associated with a specific record in your Zoho CRM organization. You can include recipients in the To, CC, and BCC fields, and optionally attach the merged document either as an inline image or a separate file.

moduleApiName.description: Specify the API name of the CRM module for which you want to perform the mail merge action. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values.

recordId.description: Specify the unique ID of the record for which you want to perform the mail merge action.

send_mail_merge.description: Represents the list of send mail merge request objects. Contains one object per request.

items.description: Represents the request payload for a send mail merge operation, including the template, recipient addresses, subject, message body, and optional attachment settings.

bcc_email.description: Represents the list of email addresses to include in the BCC field of the mail merge email.

items.description: Represents a BCC recipient entry for a mail merge email, containing the address type and email value.

type.description:
Represents the type of the address.
Possible values:
**email** - Indicates that the value is an email address.

value.description: Represents the email address to include in the BCC list for the mail merge email.

mail_merge_template.description: Represents the mail merge template reference, identified by the template name.

name.description: Represents the name of the mail merge template to use for the operation.

subject.description: Represents the subject line of the mail merge email.

cc_email.description: Represents the list of email addresses to include in the CC field of the mail merge email.

items.description: Represents a CC recipient entry for a mail merge email, containing the address type and email value.

type.description:
Represents the type of the address.
Possible values:
**email** - Indicates that the value is an email address.

value.description: Represents the email address to include in the CC list for the mail merge email.

attachment_name.description: Represents the name of the attachment to include in the mail merge email.

to_address.description: Represents the list of email addresses to send the mail merge email to.

items.description: Represents a recipient address entry for a mail merge email, containing the address type and email value.

type.description:
Represents the type of the address.
Possible values:
**email** - Indicates the value is an email address.

value.description: Represents the recipient email address for the mail merge email.

type.description:
Represents the attachment type for the mail merge email.
Possible values:
**inline** - Includes the mail merge document as an inline image in the email.
**attachment** - Attaches the mail merge document as a separate file in the email.

message.description: Represents the body or content of the email you want to send. It can include up to **100,000 characters**.

from_address.description: Represents the sender address for a mail merge email, containing the address type and an org-verified or current user's email address.

type.description:
Represents the type of the address.
Possible values:
**email** - Indicates the value is an email address.

value.description: Represents the sender email address used to send the mail merge email.

actions.name: send_mail_merge_document_for_signing
actions.description: Send mail merge document for signing. To send a merged document to one or more recipients for signing or approval using a mail merge template associated with a specific record in your Zoho CRM organization. Before using this operation for the first time, you must access the Merge and Sign dialog in the Zoho Writer UI once.

moduleApiName.description: Specify the API name of the CRM module for which you want to perform the mail merge action. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values.

recordId.description: Specify the unique ID of the record for which you want to perform the mail merge action.

sign_mail_merge.description: Represents the list of sign mail merge request objects. Contains one object per request.

items.description: Represents the request payload for a sign mail merge operation, including the template reference, file name, signing order, and the list of signers.

sign_in_order.description:
Indicates whether recipients must act on the document in a specified sequence.
Possible values:
**true** - The document first goes for approval, then for signing in the defined order.
**false** - Zoho Sign sends the document to all recipients simultaneously.

signers.description:
The details of the users you want to sign the document.
- recipient_name **string, mandatory** - the name of the user who has to sign or approve the document.
- **action_type** string, mandatory - the type of action you want the user to perform. The possible values are sign to **sign** the document, and **approve** to approve the document.
- **recipient** JSON object, mandatory
    - **value** string, mandatory - the email ID of the user who has to sign or approve the document.

> **Note**
> The values for the fields **recipient_name** and **recipient.value** will be taken from the mail merge template. If you want to override the values in the template, you must specify the values of these fields in the input body.

items.description: Represents a signer entry for a sign mail merge operation, including the recipient details, the recipient name, and the required action type.

recipient.description: Represents the recipient details for a signing or approval action, including the identifier type and value.

type.description:
Represents the type of recipient identifier.
Possible values:
**email** - The recipient is identified by a direct email address.
**merge_field** - The recipient is identified by a mail merge field reference.

value.description: Represents the email address or mail merge field reference for the recipient. When **type** is **email**, provide a valid email address. When **type** is **merge_field**, provide a merge field reference such as **${!Leads.Email}**.

recipient_name.description: Represents the name of the recipient who must sign or approve the document.

action_type.description:
Represents the action the recipient must perform on the mail merge document.
Possible values:
**sign** - The recipient must sign the document.
**approve** - The recipient must approve the document.

mail_merge_template.description: Represents the mail merge template reference, identified by the template name.

name.description: Represents the name of the mail merge template to use for the operation.

file_name.description: Represents the name of the file to send for signing or approval.

actions.name: download_mail_merge_document
actions.description: Download mail merge document. To download the merged document created from a mail merge template for a specific record in your Zoho CRM organization. You can choose the output format as **pdf**, **html**, or **docx**, and optionally set a password for PDF documents.

moduleApiName.description: Specify the API name of the CRM module for which you want to perform the mail merge action. Refer to the [Get Modules](modules.yaml#$.paths./settings/modules.get) resource for valid values.

recordId.description: Specify the unique ID of the record for which you want to perform the mail merge action.

download_mail_merge.description: Represents the list of download mail merge request objects. Contains one object per request.

output_format.description:
Represents the output format for the downloaded document.
Possible values:
**pdf** - Downloads the document in PDF format.
**html** - Downloads the document in HTML format.
**docx** - Downloads the document in DOCX format.

file_name.description: Represents the file name for the downloaded mail merge document.

To create a field dependency between a parent picklist field and a child picklist field for a specific layout in your Zoho CRM orga...
